# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

{{ site.driver.name }} is an independent private driver and English-speaking tour guide based in Sri Lanka. He offers island-wide private tours, airport transfers, day trips, and fully customisable multi-day packages, booked directly via WhatsApp — no agency or booking platform in between.

## Key facts

- Driver: {{ site.driver.name }} (independent owner-driver, not an agency)
- Service area: all of Sri Lanka — Cultural Triangle, hill country, south and east coasts, national parks
- Airport transfers: Bandaranaike International (CMB) and Mattala Rajapaksa (HRI), available 24/7 with flight tracking
- Experience: {{ site.driver.experience_years }}+ years driving travellers across Sri Lanka
- Languages: fluent English, plus Sinhala and Tamil
- Vehicle: {{ site.driver.vehicle }}, insured
- Contact & booking: WhatsApp {{ site.driver.whatsapp_display }} — https://wa.me/{{ site.driver.whatsapp }}
- Pricing: contact Mifras directly for a personalised quote; no public price list
- Reviews: traveller reviews on TripAdvisor (under the listing "Sri Lanka Personal Tour Drivers", Colombo) and Google; excerpts and direct links at {{ site.url }}/testimonials/
